result.summary: The page is generally polished, but it shows a likely navigation-state mismatch and several viewport/overflow issues that make content appear clipped or obscured.

issues.description: The restaurant discovery feed is displayed while the Profile tab in the bottom navigation is highlighted as active.
issues.suggestion: Set Home as the active navigation item for this feed, or display the Profile screen when Profile is selected.

issues.description: Horizontal content is visibly clipped at the right edge: the category row shows a partial next pill, and the third restaurant card and its name are cut off.
issues.suggestion: Implement a clearly intentional horizontal carousel with a visible scroll affordance, or constrain cards to the viewport and avoid awkward text clipping.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlays the next restaurant card, cutting off its image/content without visible bottom spacing.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable page so the final card can scroll fully above the fixed navigation bar.

issues.description: The partially visible category pill at the far right appears as an unlabeled light-gray sliver, which can look like an accidental rendering artifact.
issues.suggestion: Show a deliberate portion of the next category with consistent spacing, or hide overflow until the user starts scrolling.
